name: Seed Line Integral Convolution
definition: A method for computing volume LIC textures that exploits the sparsity of the input texture by calculating field lines and computing the convolution starting from a set of distributed points (seed points) only, rather than covering every voxel in the output texture.
summary: Seed LIC is a volume rendering technique that computes textures only along field lines from sparse seed points, offering higher efficiency for sparse inputs than standard Fast LIC.
